current_runtime_note: This preflight predates the delivered City Hunter. The active CityHunterRig now supplies two independently weighted hair chains; wristblades and gauntlets remain static. See ../MODEL-FIDELITY-AUDIT.md and ../qa/insertion-reference-review.md for the current limits.

generation_authorization.scope_requested: Continue the other playable Yautja using verified photo cutouts, with independently animated dreadlocks, wristblades and gauntlets.

local_articulation.dreadlocks: Actual weighted bone chains or separately segmented strand meshes; per-actor secondary simulation.
local_articulation.wristblades: Separate blade geometry with a measured retraction axis and travel.
local_articulation.gauntlets: Variant-specific forearm equipment: sliding blades, pivoted lid or Feral folding shield only where supported by references.
local_articulation.limitation: Meshy humanoid rig alone does not supply hair chains or moving mechanisms. Auto Split is being piloted on the fused existing Hunter; it rebuilds cuts and removes original textures. It is not lossless loose-parts splitting.
local_articulation.runtime_hook: ImportedCharacter consumes optional characterRig.articulation only when supplied; no current manifest model supplies this descriptor.

reference_gate.mask_eye_semantics: Preserve observed photo surfaces. City Hunter has opaque grids. The inspected Feral reference has a continuous bone cover and lower mandibular notches, not artificial eye holes. Declare true apertures only when documented.

pricing.dreadlock_rigging_and_mechanical_assembl: Local work after actual part geometry is inspected; no additional Meshy API operation budgeted.
pricing.note: City Hunter only has explicit75-credit approval. Other five characters and paid reruns are not approved. Earlier750proposal remains suspended.

network_requirements.actual_access: PlayStation Blog and NECA HTTP200 verified for reference research; environment network readiness state remains unknown.

pilot.target: Separate existing Jungle Hunter into eight named parts; preserve assembled transforms; no connectors; GLB.
pilot.activation: Do not activate any split result before scene/topology/silhouette and texture-loss review.
pilot.qa_conclusion: Useful separated parts but require anatomical reassembly, actual hair weighting, measured mechanical axes/pivots and restoration of UV/normals/PBR. No ready-to-animate1:1 result.
